parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of target instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to query target instance ID.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description: The name of the ApsaraDB for HBase instance.

parameters.name: DbType
parameters.description:
The service type. Valid values:
- **hbase**: ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition or ApsaraDB for HBase single-node.
- **hbaseue**: ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition.
- **bds**: BDS data synchronization service.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the instance list. Minimum value: **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of rows to display per page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region to which the instance belongs. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the region ID.

> If you specify the **Tag.N.Key** and **Tag.N.Value** parameters, this parameter is required.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. You can query the resource group ID in the Resource Group console.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag. The tag key and tag value form a key-value pair in the format of {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag key. The tag value and tag key form a key-value pair.
